model_annotation: The donut chart, titled "Task Type," visually represents the distribution of two task types in the context of generative AI use in journalism at Agency A. The chart is divided into two segments: the larger segment, colored in red, corresponds to "Article generation" and accounts for 83.2% of the total, while the smaller segment, colored in yellow, represents "Headline generation" at 16.8%. The percentages are explicitly labeled next to each respective segment, and the chart includes a central white circle with the label "Task Type" in bold black text. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right, with the article generation segment occupying the majority of the chart’s circumference. There is no legend, but the labels are directly associated with their corresponding colored slices.
